name: OpenBinding
yaml:
syntaxVersion: '3.1'
saasName: OpenBinding
version: 0.2.0
createdAt: '2026-10-22'
currency: EUR
billing:
  monthly: 1
tags:
- Repository
- Laboratory
- Engines
- Collaboration
features:
  repository:
    description: Author, version and publish binding problems and collections, with permanent links, citations and
      verification.
    tag: Repository
    type: DOMAIN
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['repository']
  runs:
    description: Run problem versions on the built-in engines; the platform re-evaluates every result.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: DOMAIN
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['runs'] && subscriptionContext['solverHours'] < pricingContext['usageLimits']['solverHours']
  studies:
    description: Compare engines over problems or a collection with budgets and seeds, read the protocol metrics and
      publish frozen, citable results.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: DOMAIN
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['studies'] && subscriptionContext['solverHours'] < pricingContext['usageLimits']['solverHours']
  generator:
    description: Generate problem collections with the solver-aware generator, with provenance.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: DOMAIN
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['generator'] && subscriptionContext['generatedInstances'] < pricingContext['usageLimits']['generatedInstances']
  federatedEngines:
    description: Register remote engines that pass conformance and run problems on them.
    tag: Engines
    type: INTEGRATION
    integrationType: API
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['federatedEngines']
  collaboration:
    description: Organizations, projects and members with roles; projects are public or private.
    tag: Collaboration
    type: MANAGEMENT
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['collaboration']
  apiAccess:
    description: Use the public API with API keys, from scripts, QACOBench or MCP clients.
    tag: Collaboration
    type: INTEGRATION
    integrationType: API
    valueType: BOOLEAN
    defaultValue: true
    expression: pricingContext['features']['apiAccess']
usageLimits:
  maxProblems:
    description: Problems the account owns in the repository, public or private.
    tag: Repository
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 25
    unit: problem
    linkedFeatures:
    - repository
  maxCollections:
    description: Collections the account owns in the repository.
    tag: Repository
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 5
    unit: collection
    linkedFeatures:
    - repository
  maxRepositoryStorage:
    description: Stored size of every version of the problems and collections the account owns.
    tag: Repository
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 500
    unit: MB
    linkedFeatures:
    - repository
  solverHours:
    description: Solver time on the built-in engines per account and month; each run counts its time budget when it
      starts.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: RENEWABLE
    period:
      value: 1
      unit: MONTH
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 5
    unit: hour/month
    linkedFeatures:
    - runs
    - studies
  maxRunMinutes:
    description: Largest time budget of one run.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 5
    unit: minute
    linkedFeatures:
    - runs
    - studies
  maxConcurrentRuns:
    description: Runs of one account executing at the same time, on built-in or federated engines.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 1
    unit: run
    linkedFeatures:
    - runs
    - studies
    - generator
    - federatedEngines
  maxStudyCells:
    description: Cells (problem version × engine mode × budget × seed) in one study run.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 500
    unit: cell
    linkedFeatures:
    - studies
  generatedInstances:
    description: Problem instances the generator writes per account and month; each generated instance counts once.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: RENEWABLE
    period:
      value: 1
      unit: MONTH
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 1000
    unit: instance/month
    linkedFeatures:
    - generator
  maxInstancesPerGeneration:
    description: Instances in one generation request.
    tag: Laboratory
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 100
    unit: instance
    linkedFeatures:
    - generator
  maxFederatedEngines:
    description: Federated engine deployments registered by the account.
    tag: Engines
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 1
    unit: engine
    linkedFeatures:
    - federatedEngines
  maxPrivateProjects:
    description: Private projects in the organizations the account owns.
    tag: Collaboration
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 1
    unit: project
    linkedFeatures:
    - collaboration
  maxApiKeys:
    description: Active API keys of the account.
    tag: Collaboration
    type: NON_RENEWABLE
    trackable: false
    valueType: NUMERIC
    defaultValue: 2
    unit: key
    linkedFeatures:
    - apiAccess
plans:
  FREE:
    description: For any researcher. Author, run, compare, generate and publish binding problems, with a repository
      sized for one author.
    price: 0
    unit: user/month
    features:
      repository:
        value: true
      runs:
        value: true
      studies:
        value: true
      generator:
        value: true
      federatedEngines:
        value: true
      collaboration:
        value: true
      apiAccess:
        value: true
    usageLimits:
      maxProblems:
        value: 25
      maxCollections:
        value: 5
      maxRepositoryStorage:
        value: 500
      solverHours:
        value: 5
      maxRunMinutes:
        value: 5
      maxConcurrentRuns:
        value: 1
      maxStudyCells:
        value: 500
      generatedInstances:
        value: 1000
      maxInstancesPerGeneration:
        value: 100
      maxFederatedEngines:
        value: 1
      maxPrivateProjects:
        value: 1
      maxApiKeys:
        value: 2
  RESEARCH:
    description: Free for Universidad de Sevilla members who sign in with CAS. An unlimited repository and
      research-scale laboratory limits.
    price: 0
    unit: user/month
    features:
      repository:
        value: true
      runs:
        value: true
      studies:
        value: true
      generator:
        value: true
      federatedEngines:
        value: true
      collaboration:
        value: true
      apiAccess:
        value: true
    usageLimits:
      maxProblems:
        value: .inf
      maxCollections:
        value: .inf
      maxRepositoryStorage:
        value: .inf
      solverHours:
        value: 100
      maxRunMinutes:
        value: 30
      maxConcurrentRuns:
        value: 4
      maxStudyCells:
        value: 5000
      generatedInstances:
        value: 100000
      maxInstancesPerGeneration:
        value: 10000
      maxFederatedEngines:
        value: 3
      maxPrivateProjects:
        value: 10
      maxApiKeys:
        value: 10
  LAB:
    description: By agreement, for groups that run benchmark campaigns or operate engines. Campaign-scale solver time,
      concurrency and generation.
    price: Contact us
    unit: user/month
    features:
      repository:
        value: true
      runs:
        value: true
      studies:
        value: true
      generator:
        value: true
      federatedEngines:
        value: true
      collaboration:
        value: true
      apiAccess:
        value: true
    usageLimits:
      maxProblems:
        value: .inf
      maxCollections:
        value: .inf
      maxRepositoryStorage:
        value: .inf
      solverHours:
        value: 10000
      maxRunMinutes:
        value: 1440
      maxConcurrentRuns:
        value: 32
      maxStudyCells:
        value: 500000
      generatedInstances:
        value: 1000000
      maxInstancesPerGeneration:
        value: 100000
      maxFederatedEngines:
        value: 50
      maxPrivateProjects:
        value: 500
      maxApiKeys:
        value: 200
